question.text: Per SEBI's December 10, 2021 circular, how must the Investor Charter be communicated to investors of Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund?

answer.text: For new schemes: disclose in the PPM. For existing schemes: disclose to investors on their registered e-mail ID as a one-time measure.
Only to institutional investors above INR 10 crore.
By publication in two English national dailies every quarter.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5.1 states: 'For new schemes, the AIF should disclose the Investor Charter in the PPM. For existing schemes, the AIF should disclose the Investor Charter to the investors on their registered e-mail ID, as a one-time measure.' The Trap: Options B, C and D invent thresholds or channels not in the circular. The dual-route (PPM vs e-mail) is the examinable rule. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same circular. XIX-B tests how the Charter affects client onboarding. XXI-B PMS also has an investor charter with similar structure. Manager's Pro-Tip: Tag the Investor Charter in every welcome e-mail template for new subscribers of your Cat III — automatic inclusion of the Charter demonstrates compliance and reduces grievance-handling friction.
